summary.name: Kipimo
summary.one_liner: Kipimo is a free, open-source Mac menu bar system monitor that also offers cleanup, app uninstall, disk-usage and startup-item tools.
use_cases: Monitor CPU, memory, battery and network from the menu bar
Completely uninstall a Mac app with its leftover files
Check which startup items run at login
Check whether macOS malware protection is on
summary.what_it_does: Kipimo lives in the Mac menu bar; clicking the icon opens a panel that refreshes every 2 seconds (or every second if set in Settings). When closed, it checks once a minute and colours the menu bar icon if something needs attention. The panel has cards for overall Mac Health, XProtect protection status, startup disk free space with a Clean up button, memory pressure, battery charge and wattage, CPU load, chip temperature and busiest app, network upload and download speed, Bluetooth device battery levels, and a daily recommendation. Per the listing, it also clears caches, uninstalls apps with their leftovers, finds what fills the disk and reviews startup items, moving removed files to the Trash.
notable: Open source, hosted on GitHub under piedol/kipimo
Menu bar panel with live CPU, memory, battery, network and Bluetooth device stats
Removes apps with leftovers and moves files to the Trash rather than deleting permanently
caveats: Mac only; the page names no other platforms
Page does not state any paid tier, so pricing is listed as free based on the listing's 'Freeware' label
